title: Instruments, apparatus and models, designed for demonstrational purposes, unsuitable for other uses

review.classification: CPC 3.0 38996 requires demonstration as the design function and unsuitability for other uses. The manufacturer identifies a synthetic model that reproduces the anatomy for teaching. Its model safety sheet assigns it exclusively to education and demonstration and rules out medical or surgical application. Distinguish anatomical specimens of collectors interest and display or toy articles.
review.primary_evidence: The original A10 product record specifies final assembly by hand, break-resistant synthetic material, removable arms and legs and distinct mounting options. Page one of the original assembly booklet shows the skull, removable limb connections, pelvic support shaft and caster stand, with the A10 reference. The illustration demonstrates which connections exist. Actual shop order, acceptance records and customer instructions identify who completed a specific operation. SOMSO separately offers an articulated artificial teaching model on a wheeled stand. No material, weight or configuration is inferred across manufacturers.
review.readiness: Candidate methodology and aligned translated text. Order-specific inputs, provider data, exact exchange identities and the separate scientific and translation review decisions remain qualified as recorded.
review.measurement_and_review: In the initial author commit d5715a37630d9785fce4680a3829372c19544b22, the assembly and finished-goods electricity cards assigned a fuel calorific value property to an electrical meter. The controller identified the mismatch and supplied an archived technical Energy property. In c5fecbb76a90c2db8ca26c4093a366e8b90e100b both languages use Energy for the physical meter quantity. The verified unit-group ID supports MJ/kWh and the property references a different version than the retained unit-group XML. The exact provider flow/property and exact version match remain explicit gaps. Reviewed the mass reference, separate parts and whole-model release, receipt custody and first-release/packing/classroom boundaries. Both languages have 50 corresponding exchange cards. Independent target check performed 253 measurements with zero skips and 24 retained range warnings.
